title: Design Engineer
description:
**Overview** 

 We are looking for a talented and user\-centered Designer to join our dynamic design team. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping intuitive, accessible, and visually compelling digital experiences across web and mobile platforms.
   

 You will work closely with design engineers, developers, and stakeholders to transform complex problems into simple, meaningful, and seamless user experiences. We are looking for someone who combines strong visual design, solid UX fundamentals, systems thinking, and an AI\-driven design process to create thoughtful solutions that balance user needs with business goals.
   




**What You’ll Do** 
- Translate complex user and business problems into intuitive user journeys and digital experiences.

- Create user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.

- Apply strong UX fundamentals and visual design principles to create clear, consistent, and engaging experiences.

- Use AI as an integral part of your design process for research, ideation, exploration, prototyping, content, analysis, and design iteration.

- Develop interactive prototypes that effectively simulate real\-world interactions and support usability testing.

- Apply systems thinking to understand interconnected user, product, and business problems and design scalable solutions.

- Understand front\-end fundamentals and use your knowledge of HTML and CSS to communicate effectively with developers and ensure design feasibility.

- Consider accessibility, usability, responsiveness, and consistency across web and mobile experiences.

- Present and communicate design decisions clearly through strong storytelling, rationale, and visual communication.

- Manage multiple projects, incorporate feedback constructively, and work effectively in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.

 Requirements
   

  

**What We’re Looking For** 
- 3–5 years of professional experience in Visual/UX Design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end design projects.

- Strong visual sense with a good understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and visual consistency.

- Strong UX fundamentals, including user research, information architecture, user flows, interaction design, usability, and accessibility.

- An AI\-driven design mindset which demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools and workflows into the design process to improve exploration, speed, quality, and decision\-making.

- Strong proficiency in wire\-framing, prototyping, and high\-fidelity UI design.

- Experience creating interactive prototypes that simulate real user interactions and help validate design decisions.

- Strong systems thinking and the ability to break down complex problems into simple, scalable experiences.

- Working knowledge of HTML and CSS and an understanding of how digital products are implemented.

- Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate the "why" behind design decisions.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, work independently, respond to feedback, and thrive in a fast\-paced agile environment.

 Benefits
   

  

**What We Offer** 
* **Flexible Working Hours** 
 — Flexibility to structure your workday around your most productive hours.
* **Work From Home** 
 — Flexibility to work remotely when required.
* **Food Coupons** 
 — Employee food benefits to support your everyday work experience.
* **Team Outings** 
 — Regular team experiences and outings beyond the workplace.
* **Team Lunches \& Dinners** 
 — Opportunities to connect, collaborate, and unwind together.
* **Health Insurance** 
 — Employee insurance coverage for added peace of mind.
* **Learning \& Development** 
 — Opportunities to continuously learn, experiment, and grow through new skills, tools, and experiences.
